raw_plan.original_behavior: Stores the input pointer, calls sprintf(dest=[rbp-0x20], fmt=0x10004cf, input) with no length limit, then calls puts(dest), then verifies the stack canary and returns.
raw_plan.required_invariant: At most 15 bytes plus a NUL terminator may be written into the 16-byte destination buffer at [rbp-0x20]; the stack canary at [rbp-8] and saved rbp/return address must remain unmodified.

raw_plan.failure_behavior: For inputs that do not fit, do not call sprintf into the buffer; return without writing past the buffer (e.g., skip the copy/print and return cleanly through the existing canary-check epilogue).
raw_plan.expected_behavior: Valid inputs that format to at most 15 bytes are copied into [rbp-0x20] and printed via puts exactly as before; oversized inputs are rejected without overflowing the buffer, and the function returns with the stack canary intact.

Inputs producing >15 bytes do not modify memory beyond [rbp-0x20]+15
